# Development Tasks

This project uses [mise] to manage development tools and run common tasks. Mise ensures everyone uses the same tool
versions and provides convenient commands for formatting, linting, testing, and more.

If you prefer not to use mise, all tasks have equivalent shell scripts in the `bin/` directory.

## Quick Reference

```bash
mise run spec         # Run tests with coverage
mise run format       # Format all files (Ruby, Markdown)
mise run lint         # Lint all files
mise run build        # Build the gem
```

## Without Mise

Run scripts directly from `bin/`:

```bash
./bin/format/ruby        # Instead of: mise run format:ruby
./bin/lint/ruby          # Instead of: mise run lint:ruby
./bin/spec               # Instead of: mise run spec
./bin/build              # Instead of: mise run build
```

When running scripts directly, ensure required tools are installed and available in your PATH.

## Toolchain

Tools managed by mise (see `.config/mise.toml`):

- **Ruby 3.2** - Runtime
- **editorconfig-checker** - EditorConfig validation
- **markdownlint-cli2** - Markdown linting and formatting

[mise]: https://mise.jdx.dev/
